features.title: Answer ctx.web searches with Brave Web Search
features.summary: A Brave backend for the web search seam: the API key setting holds a Secret Catalog reference resolved on the Host per search (falling back to BRAVE_API_KEY), results are stripped of markup, deduplicated by URL and mapped to sources.
failureModes: No resolvable key fails with WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING.
An HTTP error, invalid JSON, an unexpected shape or no results fail with WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR instead of returning nothing.
A caller abort is reported as WEB_ABORTED.

externalDependencies.boundary: GET https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search with the resolved key, 15 s timeout.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/brave.test.ts injects a fetch that answers fixed Brave-shaped responses and status codes.

verification.testName: removes tags, decodes entities and collapses whitespace
maps results, strips markup and dedupes by URL
refuses an unexpected shape instead of returning nothing
calls the Brave endpoint with the key and maps the response
surfaces a rejected key with guidance
reports a caller abort as WEB_ABORTED

verification.reason: The backend calls the fixed public Brave endpoint from the Host with no base-URL override, so a browser journey would need a real key and the live network; the request, mapping and failure paths run against an injected fetch in tests/brave.test.ts.
